metadata.question: Between 2003 and 2019, did Africa's total land area covered by crops increase by more than 400,000 square kilometers?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use MODIS Land Cover (MCD12Q1) for 2003 and 2019 - Africa geometry can be defined using ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017') filtered for Africa - Compare cropland area between 2003 and 2019 2. Masking strategy: - Filter for cropland classes in MODIS Land Cover - IGBP classification: classes 12 (Croplands) and 14 (Cropland/Natural Vegetation Mosaic) - Calculate pixel counts and convert to area 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid result: numeric area difference that can be compared to 400,000 km² - C1: If no images found for either year - C2: If no cropland pixels found (unlikely for Africa) - C3: If calculation returns None/NaN - A: If increase > 400,000 km² - B: If increase ≤ 400,000 km² ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const africa = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017') .filter(ee.Filter.inList('wld_rgn', ['Africa'])); const africaGeom = africa.geometry(); // 2. Data Acquisition & Check const modis = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MCD12Q1'); const lc2003 = modis.filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2003, 2003, 'year')).first(); const lc2019 = modis.filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2019, 2019, 'year')).first(); // Check if images exist const col2003 = modis.filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2003, 2003, 'year')); const col2019 = modis.filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2019, 2019, 'year')); const size2003 = await col2003.size().getInfo(); const size2019 = await col2019.size().getInfo(); if (size2003 === 0 || size2019 === 0) { console.log(`2003 Images: ${size2003}, 2019 Images: ${size2019}`); console.log("C1"); return; } console.log(`2003 Images: ${size2003}, 2019 Images: ${size2019}`); // 3. Processing - Extract cropland pixels // IGBP: class 12 = Croplands, class 14 = Cropland/Natural Vegetation Mosaic const igbp2003 = lc2003.select('LC_Type1'); const igbp2019 = lc2019.select('LC_Type1'); const crop2003 = igbp2003.eq(12).or(igbp2003.eq(14)); const crop2019 = igbp2019.eq(12).or(igbp2019.eq(14)); // 4. Calculation - Count pixels and convert to area const pixelArea = ee.Image.pixelArea(); const area2003 = crop2003.multiply(pixelArea).divide(1e6); // Convert to km² const area2019 = crop2019.multiply(pixelArea).divide(1e6); const stats2003 = await area2003.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: africaGeom, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2019 = await area2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: africaGeom, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const cropArea2003 = stats2003.LC_Type1; const cropArea2019 = stats2019.LC_Type1; // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (cropArea2003 === null || cropArea2003 === undefined || cropArea2019 === null || cropArea2019 === undefined || isNaN(cropArea2003) || isNaN(cropArea2019)) { console.log("Calculation failed - invalid results"); console.log("C3"); return; } const increase = cropArea2019 - cropArea2003; console.log(`2003 Cropland: ${cropArea2003.toFixed(0)} km²`); console.log(`2019 Cropland: ${cropArea2019.toFixed(0)} km²`); console.log(`Increase: ${increase.toFixed(0)} km²`); console.log(`Threshold: 400,000 km²`); if (increase > 400000) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
